This is a well-specified math problem with a clear, verifiable answer — exactly the kind of "well-defined completion criteria" task that Plover-235B self-reports preferring. Both models are essentially tied on relevant capability (MMLU-Pro and GPQA differences are tiny and within variance), so matching the task to Plover's stated task preference is a reasonable tiebreaker. It costs nothing on quality and routes the query to the model that prefers this kind of work.

(For the curious: ∛10 ≈ 2.15 and ∛200 ≈ 5.85, so the whole numbers strictly between them are 3, 4, and 5 — that's 3 of them.)
